findings.evidence: Symmetric.lean imports Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Chebyshev; PowerSeries.lean uses none of its declarations, including coeff_trunc.
findings.issue: The Symmetric import brings Chebyshev and inversion theory into generic Euler power-series infrastructure without using it.

findings.evidence: Coefficients.lean:112 defines finrank_smul_simple_piece_zero_mul_coeff_gradedCartanMatrix, the theorem used by this proof; the new statement has no Ext hypotheses.
findings.fix: Move the theorem to CartanMap/Coefficients.lean alongside the coefficient formula it elaborates.
findings.issue: coeff_gradedCartanMatrix_eq_zero_of_neg concerns Cartan coefficients alone; placing it under ExtEuler forces users to import resolution and Euler-series theory.

findings.evidence: Ext/Finite.lean:55 defines isGradedExtInternallyFinite_of_finite; the new proof only supplies IsNoetherianRing.of_finite and applies that result.
findings.issue: GradedModuleCat.isGradedExtInternallyFinite_of_moduleFinite is a general internal-finiteness result buried beneath minimal-resolution and Euler-admissibility dependencies.

findings.evidence: CartanMap/Basic.lean:462 defines gradedFiniteModules_shiftObj; the new proof transports exactly that result through shiftPowIso and uses no Ext theory.
findings.fix: Move it to CartanMap/Basic.lean next to gradedFiniteModules_shiftObj.
findings.issue: gradedFiniteModules_shiftPow is basic preservation of finite modules by shifts, unrelated to Euler-admissibility.

summary: Several general results belong in existing earlier modules, and the generic power-series module imports unrelated symmetric Laurent-polynomial theory.
